name: In-Line On/Off Module with Sense

steps.text: Write down the Insteon ID and the fixture where the module is being installed.
Turn off the circuit breaker or fuse supplying power to the fixture, and check that the power is off by switching the load on and off from its local switch.
Remove the wallplate from the fixture, unscrew it and remove it from the junction box.
Disconnect the wires from the fixture; if they cannot be unscrewed, cut them and strip 1/2 in. of insulation off the ends. Make sure the wires are not touching anything.
Turn on the circuit breaker.
Identify the line, load, neutral and ground wires with a voltage meter.
Turn off the circuit breaker again.

With the included wire nuts, connect the fixture's line, load, neutral, ground and (if used) sense wires to the module's corresponding wires: line black, load red, neutral white, ground bare copper, sense yellow. A neutral connection is required.
Turn the power back on at the circuit breaker or fuse panel.
Test the installation with the module's On and Off buttons.
Link the module to an Insteon controller (or, with the sense wire, to its responders) before finishing the installation.
Gently place the module into the junction box, making sure nothing could accidentally press the buttons on its face.
Reinstall the fixture.

notes: The sense wire is enabled by default; if you do not use it, disable it before completing installation: press and hold the SET button until it beeps (3 seconds), then double-tap the SET button.
Use a non-conductive probe to press the SET button.
Pulling the SET button all the way out opens the air gap; push it back in until it is flush with the trim frame.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the module beeps (3 seconds).
steps.expect: Status LED blinks; the module stays in linking mode for four minutes

notes: As a controller: put the module in linking mode first, set the responder to the desired state, then press and hold the responder's SET button for about 3 seconds; the module double-beeps and its status LED stops blinking and turns on solid.

As a responder: put the controller in linking mode first (for most controllers, press and hold the SET button for 3 seconds or an On or scene button for 10 seconds), then press and hold the module's SET button until it double-beeps (3 seconds); the status LED flashes once, then turns on if the load is off or off if the load is on.
Link the module before finishing installation.

verification.note: The In-Line On/Off Module with Sense 2475S2 Owner's Manual's linking section says to hold the SET button until the module beeps; its X10 section says to hold it until it double-beeps to enter linking mode. The catalog uses the linking section's single beep.

steps.text: Have the Hub start ALL-Linking as the controller, for group 0.
Press and hold the SET button until the module beeps (3 seconds).
steps.expect: Status LED blinks; the module stays in linking mode for four minutes

steps.text: Wait for the Hub to report the new link.
steps.expect: The Hub reports ALL-Linking Completed with the device's Insteon ID

steps.text: Have the Hub send ID Request.
steps.expect: The device answers with its category, subcategory and firmware version

steps.text: Have the Hub send Enter Linking Mode (cmd1 0x09) with cmd2 0x01, for group 1: as an extended message if Get Insteon Engine Version (cmd1 0x0D) says the device is i2CS, and as a standard message otherwise.
Have the Hub start ALL-Linking as the responder.
steps.expect: The Hub reports ALL-Linking Completed with the device's Insteon ID

steps.text: Have the Hub send Ping to confirm the link.

notes: This links the Hub's group 0 to the device as a responder, and the device's group 1 to the Hub as a controller, so the Hub receives the device's reports.

To add the device without its SET button, have the Hub send it Enter Linking Mode (cmd1 0x09, cmd2 0x01; extended for an i2CS device) right after it starts ALL-Linking, in place of the SET button step.

verification.note: Assembled from this profile's linking steps and the standard Insteon commands Start ALL-Linking, ID Request, Enter Linking Mode and Ping; no document describes adding this product to a Hub.

steps.text: Adjust each responder to the desired state.
Press and hold the SET button until the module beeps.
Tap the SET button until the module beeps again.
steps.expect: Multi-linking mode starts and lasts four minutes

steps.text: One at a time, press and hold each responder's SET button for about 3 seconds.
After linking all responders, tap the SET button.
Test by tapping the module's On and Off buttons.
Press and hold the SET button until the module beeps.
Press and hold the SET button until the module beeps again.
steps.expect: Status LED keeps blinking; the module stays in unlinking mode for four minutes

notes: As a controller: after entering unlinking mode, press and hold the responder's SET button for about 3 seconds; the module double-beeps and its status LED stops blinking.

As a responder: put the controller in unlinking mode first (for most controllers, press and hold the SET button for 3 seconds twice or an On or scene button for 10 seconds twice), then press and hold the module's SET button until it double-beeps.
To unlink several responders at once, tap the SET button after entering unlinking mode, press and hold each responder's SET button for about 3 seconds, then tap the SET button to finish.

steps.text: Make sure the module is unlinked from all controllers.
Turn off the breaker supplying power to the module's fixture.
Wait 10 seconds.
Push in the SET button and hold it; while you keep holding it, have a partner turn on the circuit breaker.
Release the SET button.
steps.expect: After a few seconds the module double-beeps and the load turns on

steps.text: Unlink the module from every controller that controls it.
Unlink every responder the module controls.

notes: The In-Line On/Off Module with Sense 2475S2 Owner's Manual says to unlink a module you no longer use from its controllers, and to unlink all responders from it, otherwise devices keep retrying commands and cause network delays.

steps.text: Remove the device from its scenes first, so no other device keeps links to it.
Have the Hub send Enter Unlinking Mode (cmd1 0x0A) with cmd2 0x01, for group 1, as an extended message if the device is i2CS.
Have the Hub start ALL-Linking with link code 0xFF (delete), so the device deletes its group 1 link to the Hub.
steps.expect: The device deletes its group 1 link to the Hub, and the Hub reports the device's Insteon ID

steps.text: Have the Hub start unlinking for group 0 (Start ALL-Linking with link code 0xFF).
Have the Hub send Enter Linking Mode (cmd1 0x09) with cmd2 0x01, for group 1, as an extended message if the device is i2CS.
Wait for the Hub to report that the link is gone.
steps.expect: The Hub reports the device's Insteon ID

notes: Inferred: seen on three i2CS devices (Outdoor On/Off Plug 2634-222 firmware 0x42, On/Off Plug 2635-222 firmware 0x48, I/O Module 2450 firmware 0x41) linked to a Hub 2245, these steps should remove every link between the Hub and the device with no SET button press. First the device's group 1 link: Enter Unlinking Mode (cmd1 0x0A) is sent to the device while the modem joins as responder. Then the modem's group 0 link: the modem starts ALL-Linking with link code 0xFF while the device is sent Enter Linking Mode (cmd1 0x09). This applies to the firmware versions this profile's engines give as i2CS.

Inferred: seen on an i2CS device (I/O Module 2450 firmware 0x41) linked to a Hub 2245: unlinking by the modem's own records left the device's records for the Hub's other groups, and an i2CS device answers a device that's in its ALL-Link database. So a device that still answers the Hub after removal may hold other records for it; a factory reset, as the In-Line On/Off Module with Sense 2475S2 Owner's Manual gives it, clears them. This applies to the firmware versions this profile's engines give as i2CS.

verification.note: Assembled from the standard Insteon commands Enter Unlinking Mode, Start ALL-Linking and Enter Linking Mode; no document describes removing this product from a Hub.

sources: In-Line On/Off Module with Sense 2475S2 Owner's Manual
